name: reporise
description: Repository visibility toolkit — audits and improves how a repo is found by search engines (SEO), lifted into direct answers (AEO), and cited by generative engines (GEO). Ships two skills: visibility-audit, an offline 22-check audit that produces a ranked, evidence-backed fix plan, and citation-probe, which measures whether generative engines actually name the project and who gets named instead. No API keys, no network, no telemetry.
